title: Platano Vanilla Blend
description: A ripe plantain blended with vanilla that enhances the Vanilla Minecraft experience.
body: # 🍌 Platano Vanilla Blend Enhances **Vanilla Minecraft** with performance, visuals, and small quality-of-life improvements. ## 🌍 Rendering * **Distant Horizons** — Long-distance terrain rendering. ## ⚡ Performance * FPS improvements * Memory optimization * Faster chunk loading ## 🧭 Interface * Improved inventory and menus * Better HUD and tooltips ## 🪄 Quality of Life * Small gameplay conveniences * Minor usability improvements ## 🏰 Exploration * Vanilla-style structures * Expanded dungeon variety ## 🎨 Visuals * Shader support * Vanilla-friendly resource packs ## 📜 License Platano Vanilla Blend © 2026 by Platano_Maduro86 is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0
